investment_theses.quote: Is this risky? Hell yeah. But I'm willing to take a risk on somebody who will jump in a car in LA and go for it.
I don't care that it's pre-revenue. You get the users, you can always figure out the money later.
The best companies have all had rifts, they've all had pivots. This is not a straight line.
